user.description: The inverter is read through its Solarman Wi-Fi logger. Give the logger a fixed address in your router.

data_description.host: The logger's address on your network.
data_description.port: The logger's Modbus TCP port: 8899 unless changed.
data_description.logger_serial: The serial number of the logger (on its label and in its web page), not of the inverter.

reconfigure.description: Change how the logger is reached. It must be the same inverter.

data_description.host: The logger's address on your network.
data_description.port: The logger's Modbus TCP port: 8899 unless changed.
data_description.logger_serial: The serial number of the logger, not of the inverter.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the logger. Check the address, the port and the logger's serial number: with a wrong serial the logger does not answer at all.
error.no_serial: The logger answered, but the inverter's serial number registers are empty. Is the inverter on and connected to the logger?

abort.already_configured: This inverter is already added; its connection settings were updated.
abort.already_in_progress: This inverter is already being set up.
abort.unsupported_model: This inverter (device type {device_type}) is not supported: this integration is made for the Deye SUN-5K-SG03LP1-EU.
abort.wrong_device: Another inverter answers at this address.

unsupported_model.message: This version does not support the inverter's device type {device_type}.

not_writable.message: {value} is not one of the allowed values.

write_refused.message: The inverter refused the new value: {reason}.

write_no_answer.message: The inverter did not confirm the new value, tried for {seconds} seconds: {reason}.

write_interrupted.message: Writing stopped: the integration was reloaded before the inverter confirmed the new value. Check the current value.

write_not_applied.message: The inverter did not take {value}: it reads {current}.
